fact: Presidential Decree (Decreto Presidencial) n.º 46/18 of 14 February 2018 approves the national interoperability plan PNAGIA for central and local state administration, enters into force on publication, and states that adherence of public administration services to it is mandatory; the decree is a binding executive instrument, though the plan itself says its legal-level measures are still to be legislated.

IMA says the draft Digital Government Law, of 13 chapters and 107 articles, was put to public consultation on 6 May; it is meant to set the framework for digital public services and interoperability between state institutions.
